sourceRecords.title: FLOWRA, EMEC to Develop Floating Offshore Wind Test and Demo Site
sourceRecords.sourceText: OffshoreWIND.biz reported that FLOWRA and EMEC signed an MoU to explore establishing and managing an offshore test and demonstration site for floating wind technology development. The source states that EMEC has designed a floating offshore wind test and demonstration site.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public webpage; source text stored as concise factual evidence for manual archive prototype review.
